title: Top 50 Evidence Pull List
boundary: This is a research task list, not a claim list. Pulling a record does not prove wrongdoing. Each record must be classified by what it shows, what it does not show, date, source, chain of custody and counter-source.
method: Start with the source route, not the theory.
Record the exact document title, date, author, parties and archive URL.

Classify the evidence: official disclosure, court record, regulatory filing, financial filing, foundation filing, oversight record, public archive, reputable reporting, open lead or speculation quarantined.
State what the record proves and what it cannot prove.
Feed the result into people, institution, money, Epstein, speculation or transport tracker cards.
Add confidence grade: A confirmed, B strong lead, C open lead, X rejected/speculation.

pulls.title: EFTA01104262/EFTA01104263 source map verification
pulls.recordProves: The names, labels and visible map structure contained in the source document.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Criminal conduct, passenger travel, payments, knowledge or relationship type beyond the map label.
pulls.nextAction: Confirm node names, labels, page split and relationship-line visibility; attach boundary to every card.
pulls.confidenceImpact: A for map existence; C for any relationship implication until independently verified.

pulls.title: DOJ disclosure page for source context
pulls.recordProves: Government disclosure route, release context and file-set location.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Accuracy of every interpretation of the released material.
pulls.nextAction: Capture release date, dataset number and any DOJ limitations or redaction context.

pulls.title: CourtListener master Epstein docket search
pulls.recordProves: Court filings, motions, exhibits, rulings and docket events.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Claims not adopted by a court or unsupported by exhibits.
pulls.nextAction: Pull exact docket, filing number, date, parties and exhibit references.
pulls.confidenceImpact: A for filed record; B/C for allegations depending on record type.

pulls.title: SEC EDGAR entity search
pulls.recordProves: Public company filings, ownership, directors, funds, advisers and governance records.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Hidden beneficial ownership or criminal conduct unless stated by a filing or enforcement record.
pulls.nextAction: Search person, company, fund, adviser and family-office/entity names; record CIK and filing dates.
pulls.confidenceImpact: A for filings; B for network leads.

pulls.title: Investment adviser Form ADV route
pulls.recordProves: Registered adviser identity, ownership, assets under management, control persons and disciplinary disclosures where present.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Every investor, client or private relationship.
pulls.nextAction: Pull adviser brochure, control persons, related entities and disciplinary sections.

pulls.title: OpenSecrets donor/lobbying search
pulls.recordProves: Campaign donations, PACs, lobbying and political-money records.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Quid pro quo or policy control by itself.
pulls.nextAction: Record donor/entity, date, amount, recipient, committee and issue area.
pulls.confidenceImpact: A for donation/lobbying record; C for influence inference.

pulls.title: IRS tax-exempt organisation search
pulls.recordProves: Nonprofit registration, filings and tax-exempt status where available.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Hidden donor intent or private influence not in filings.
pulls.nextAction: Pull Form 990, officers, grants, revenue, program service statements and related organisations.

pulls.title: Foundation grant recipient route
pulls.recordProves: Grant-making patterns and recipient institutions where data is available.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Improper influence without supporting records.
pulls.nextAction: Log donor, recipient, amount, grant purpose, year and institutional overlap.

pulls.title: FARA records search
pulls.recordProves: Foreign-agent registration, clients, activities and filings.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Illegal foreign influence unless enforcement record says so.
pulls.nextAction: Search institution, firm, person and related country/client terms.

pulls.title: ICIJ Offshore Leaks search
pulls.recordProves: Offshore entity names, intermediaries and published leak-database relationships.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Illegality, tax evasion or beneficial ownership without context.
pulls.nextAction: Search person/entity aliases; record intermediary, jurisdiction and leak source.
pulls.confidenceImpact: B for lead; A only for database record existence.

pulls.title: PACER/CourtListener settlement language
pulls.recordProves: Settlement terms, denials, admissions, dismissals or court-approved agreements when public.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Liability if settlement denies liability or has no factual finding.
pulls.nextAction: Separate allegation, settlement, admission, finding and dismissal.
pulls.confidenceImpact: A for legal posture; variable for factual claims.

pulls.title: Bank regulator enforcement releases
pulls.recordProves: Official enforcement actions, penalties, consent orders and compliance failures.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Individual criminal knowledge beyond the enforcement finding.
pulls.nextAction: Pull action date, institution, cited failures, penalty and required remediation.

pulls.title: FinCEN public enforcement search
pulls.recordProves: AML enforcement actions and compliance findings where public.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Every underlying transaction or private client knowledge.
pulls.nextAction: Log date, institution, statute, penalty, conduct period and remediation.

pulls.title: State corporate registry searches
pulls.recordProves: Corporate entity existence, registered agent, officers where public and jurisdiction data.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Beneficial ownership or illegal purpose by itself.
pulls.nextAction: Search entity names, LLC variants and related officers; avoid private address publication.
pulls.confidenceImpact: A for entity existence; C for control inference.

pulls.title: OpenCorporates-style entity leads
pulls.recordProves: Aggregated company registry leads and officer/entity links.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Completeness or current control without original registry check.
pulls.nextAction: Use as lead, then verify through original registry.
pulls.confidenceImpact: B lead until primary registry confirms.

pulls.title: FAA registry context
pulls.recordProves: Public aircraft registry details where visible.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Passenger identity, real-time location, wrongdoing or private travel purpose.
pulls.nextAction: Use only for historical public-record context; separate owner, operator, charter and passenger claim.
pulls.confidenceImpact: A for registry record; C for travel inference.

pulls.title: FAA LADD privacy context
pulls.recordProves: Privacy/blocking mechanisms that explain missing or filtered aircraft data.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Suspicious conduct by using privacy protections.
pulls.nextAction: Cite when explaining gaps, blocked feeds or why live tracking is not used.

pulls.title: FAA ADS-B Privacy / PIA context
pulls.recordProves: FAA privacy framework around ADS-B data.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Passenger identity or wrongdoing.
pulls.nextAction: Use as boundary card for aviation evidence policy.

pulls.title: Historical flight-log court exhibits
pulls.recordProves: Historical travel records only when filed as exhibits or disclosed logs.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Purpose of travel or conduct during travel without other evidence.
pulls.nextAction: Record date, route, aircraft, source exhibit, named passengers only if public, and limitations.
pulls.confidenceImpact: A for exhibit facts; C for implication.

pulls.title: Official committee subpoenas and letters
pulls.recordProves: Congressional requests, subpoenas, public letters and oversight claims.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Final fact finding unless supported by produced records.
pulls.nextAction: Log sender, recipient, date, request, deadline and records sought.
pulls.confidenceImpact: A for oversight activity; B/C for allegations.

pulls.title: House/Senate hearing transcripts
pulls.recordProves: Statements made under hearing rules and witness testimony where transcribed.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Truth of every statement without corroboration.
pulls.nextAction: Pull transcript, witness, oath status, exhibit references and contradictions.
pulls.confidenceImpact: A for testimony existence; B for supported claim.

pulls.title: Inspector General reports
pulls.recordProves: Official oversight findings, failures, referrals and recommendations.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Claims outside report scope.
pulls.nextAction: Pull finding, agency response, corrective action and follow-up status.

pulls.title: University institutional review reports
pulls.recordProves: Institutional review findings, donation handling, policy failures and corrective actions where published.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Criminal intent without records.
pulls.nextAction: Pull report PDF, date, scope, named offices, findings and changes.

pulls.title: University gift and donor policy records
pulls.recordProves: Institution rules around accepting donations and donor influence.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Breach of rules unless specific case record exists.
pulls.nextAction: Compare policy date to donation/contact date; flag gaps.
pulls.confidenceImpact: B for policy context; A for published policy.

pulls.title: Press correction and archive comparison
pulls.recordProves: Changes over time in public pages and articles.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Intentional cover-up without additional records.
pulls.nextAction: Capture original, archived, changed and current versions with dates.
pulls.confidenceImpact: A for page change; C for motive.

pulls.title: Wayback institutional page search
pulls.recordProves: Historical existence of pages, donor pages, staff pages or event listings.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Hidden meaning beyond the archived content.
pulls.nextAction: Pull timestamped archive URLs and compare against current pages.

pulls.title: Newswire and press-release archive
pulls.recordProves: Public announcements, partnerships, grants and corporate statements.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Substance beyond PR claims.
pulls.nextAction: Record issuer, date, names, claims and later contradictions.
pulls.confidenceImpact: A for statement existence; C for truth of claim.

pulls.title: Company annual reports / 10-K risk disclosures
pulls.recordProves: Company risk disclosures, subsidiaries, governance and legal proceedings.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Undisclosed facts not in filing.
pulls.nextAction: Pull legal proceedings, related parties, risk factors and subsidiaries.

pulls.title: Board membership and governance records
pulls.recordProves: Formal board roles, committees and governance connections where filed.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Operational control unless filing says so.
pulls.nextAction: Record board role, committee, dates and related entities.
pulls.confidenceImpact: A for role if primary filing.

pulls.title: Foundation board and officer overlap
pulls.recordProves: Officers, directors, trustees and grant pathways in filings.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Coordination or improper influence by itself.
pulls.nextAction: Map overlaps between foundation, recipient institutions and policy groups.

pulls.title: Lobbying registration and client records
pulls.recordProves: Lobbying clients, issues, registrants and spending ranges.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Policy outcome causation alone.
pulls.nextAction: Record client, registrant, issue codes, amount range and bill/policy target.

pulls.title: State campaign finance databases
pulls.recordProves: State-level contributions and political-money flows.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Improper influence by itself.
pulls.nextAction: Cross-check donor/entity with federal records and policy outcomes.

pulls.title: Charity regulator records outside US
pulls.recordProves: UK charity registration, trustees, accounts and regulatory actions.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Hidden donors or misconduct outside record scope.
pulls.nextAction: Pull trustee list, accounts, related-party transactions and regulator notes.

pulls.title: European company registers / BRIS
pulls.recordProves: EU company registration leads and official registry routes.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Beneficial ownership unless shown.
pulls.nextAction: Search entity variants and verify with national registry.

pulls.title: UK Companies House
pulls.recordProves: UK company officers, filings, control statements and accounts.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Illegality or hidden control without supporting record.
pulls.nextAction: Pull PSC, officers, filing history, charges and accounts.

pulls.title: Property/entity public records without private address publication
pulls.recordProves: Public property/entity leads where available.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Current residence, private location or wrongdoing.
pulls.nextAction: Use entity-level summaries; redact private home addresses and family details.

pulls.title: Court-sealed/unsealed docket events
pulls.recordProves: Sealing, unsealing, motions and public access events.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Contents of sealed materials unless released.
pulls.nextAction: Track date, filing, seal status, judge order and released exhibits.

pulls.title: Sworn deposition excerpts
pulls.recordProves: Statements made in deposition excerpts where filed.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Truth without corroboration; excerpts may be incomplete.
pulls.nextAction: Record speaker, date, case, page/line, context and objections.
pulls.confidenceImpact: A for statement existence; B for corroborated claim.

pulls.title: Official public denial/response archive
pulls.recordProves: What a person or institution publicly denied, admitted or clarified.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Truth or falsity by itself.
pulls.nextAction: Attach denial/response to every relevant card and compare to records.

pulls.title: Reputable investigation cross-check
pulls.recordProves: Reported findings when backed by documents and named sources.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Court finding unless cited as such.
pulls.nextAction: Extract documents, named records and counter-response, not just article claims.
pulls.confidenceImpact: B until primary records are pulled.

pulls.title: Sanctions database search
pulls.recordProves: Sanctioned entities/persons in official OFAC data.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Unsanctioned related parties are guilty.
pulls.nextAction: Search names/entities and record program, date and identifiers.

pulls.title: UN sanctions list search
pulls.recordProves: UN sanctions listings and identifiers.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Facts outside listing scope.
pulls.nextAction: Record listing basis, date, identifiers and delisting status.

pulls.title: Procurement and contract records
pulls.recordProves: US federal contracts, grants and spending records.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Improper award or hidden influence without more records.
pulls.nextAction: Search institution/entity, award date, amount, agency and contract purpose.

pulls.title: EU transparency register
pulls.recordProves: EU lobbying/influence registration and declared interests.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Undeclared influence or misconduct.
pulls.nextAction: Record registrant, clients, declared interests and policy areas.

pulls.title: Public calendar and visitor log records
pulls.recordProves: Visits, meetings or scheduled contacts when officially released.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Meeting content unless notes/transcripts exist.
pulls.nextAction: Record date, visitor, host, location, source and purpose if stated.
pulls.confidenceImpact: A for log entry; C for motive.

pulls.title: FOIA reading rooms
pulls.recordProves: Released public records and agency-produced documents.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Completeness of withheld/redacted records.
pulls.nextAction: Search agency, name, topic, date; record exemptions/redactions.

pulls.title: CIA Reading Room context search
pulls.recordProves: Declassified or released CIA documents and historical context.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Current operations or claims beyond document scope.
pulls.nextAction: Search exact names/topics; capture document number, date and redactions.
pulls.confidenceImpact: A for released document; C for broad inference.

pulls.title: FBI Vault records
pulls.recordProves: Released FBI records and FOIA material.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Everything known by FBI or hidden records.
pulls.nextAction: Pull file title, section, page, date, redactions and cross-reference to court records.

pulls.title: National Archives Catalog
pulls.recordProves: Archived government records, photographs, files and descriptions.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: Interpretation beyond the archive description and file contents.
pulls.nextAction: Pull identifier, record group, date, agency, description and scan availability.

pulls.title: Counter-source and falsification pull
pulls.recordProves: Whether a claim has been corrected, debunked, rejected in court, misdated or misidentified.
pulls.recordDoesNotProve: The opposite claim automatically; it narrows the evidence boundary.
pulls.nextAction: Attach counter-source to every high-risk claim before publishing or upgrading confidence.
pulls.confidenceImpact: Can downgrade C/B claims or mark X rejected.
